name: Holiday Bike Parade in Historic Cocoa Village
address: Cocoa Riverfront Park, Historic Cocoa Village, Cocoa, FL 32922
when_note: Check-in 5 to 6:15 PM, parade starts at 6:30 PM, music and awards until 9 PM
paras: Historic Cocoa Village hosts its Holiday Bike Parade on Friday, December 18, 2026, presented by Village Cycle Shoppe. Riders check in at the Cocoa Riverfront Park bandshell from 5 PM to 6:15 PM, where judges look over the decorated bikes for trophies such as best young family entry. The parade starts at 6:30 PM and Santa leads the way on his penny-farthing.

The route is a little less than two miles, takes about 30 minutes and makes two loops through the Village before ending back at the park. Families who want a shorter ride can loop once. Afterward there is hot cocoa, a photo booth, live music and an awards ceremony until 9 PM. Every rider needs their own registration form, the village asks that only confident young bike riders join, and food donations for the Central Brevard Sharing Center are collected at check-in.
tip: Register every rider ahead and loop the route once with little ones.

name: Hot Cocoa Crawl in Historic Cocoa Village
address: Myrt Tharpe Square, 12 Stone St, Cocoa, FL 32922
when_note: Cookie tins sold 12 to 3 PM at the gazebo, crawl runs to 4 PM
paras: Historic Cocoa Village marks National Hot Cocoa Day with its Hot Cocoa Crawl on Saturday, December 12, 2026, from noon to 4 PM. Families buy a $15 cookie tin at the Myrt Tharpe Square gazebo at 12 Stone St between noon and 3 PM, and the village recommends one tin per family.

The tin and a map take you to participating Village businesses, where each shop hands over a hot cocoa themed treat and signs the map. Visitors who collect every signature enter a drawing for a grand prize. The village's Hot Cocoa Holidays series runs from November 28 through December 23.
tip: Pick up the tin before 3 PM so there is time to visit every shop.

name: 3rd Annual Christmas Market on Magnolia
paras: Visit Space Coast lists the 3rd Annual Christmas Market on Magnolia on Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 3 to 7 PM at First Baptist Church Merritt Island, 140 Magnolia Ave. The listing describes a family evening with live music, local vendors and food trucks.

Kids can visit Santa and the Grinch and join children's activities that include holiday crafts. The tourism board's listing gives a contact phone number of 407-924-7116 and does not print an admission price.
tip: Come early in the 3 to 7 PM window for the Santa and Grinch visits.
